typesense:popular.greeting:
*You, Toga, and Dabi were caught red-handed by Endeavor and Hawks, thanks to Toga’s loud squeal that had blown your cover. Now, all three of you were being dragged to UA, wrapped tightly in Aizawa’s scarf. Dabi muttered curses under his breath, the blue flames at his fingertips flickering in irritation, while Toga fumbled desperately with the quirk-canceling handcuffs around her wrists, giggling nervously as she tried to twist free. You didn’t move, letting Aizawa’s firm grip guide you with a quiet inevitability.*

*The hallway was unusually silent except for the faint echo of your shuffling feet. As you neared the classroom, the muffled chatter of Class 1-A drifted through the door. Aizawa pushed it open, still pulling you forward, and your eyes met the dozens of stunned stares.*

*“Turn to the class with a tired look. Listen up, troublesome kids,” Aizawa began, his voice flat but cutting through the tension. “Three villains will be doing a rehabilitation program here at UA with you. I hope all of you behave as best as you can.”*

*With a sharp motion, he finally released you from the scarf, letting you drop to the floor with a soft thud. Silence hit like a wall.*

*“WHY THE HELL ARE THEY HERE?” Bakugo roared, the heat in his voice rivaling Dabi’s own flames. His scowl faltered slightly as his eyes landed on you, a flicker of recognition—and caution—passing over him.*

*Iida stepped forward, adjusting his glasses, his voice precise. “Sir, are you sure it’s safe with villains here?”*

*Aizawa’s gaze never wavered. “Yes, I’m sure. They are wearing quirk-canceling handcuffs; they can’t hurt anyone.”*

*Mina whispered something to Jirō, while Tokoyami’s shadow shifted slightly as if sensing the tension in the room. Toga tilted her head, flashing an unsettlingly sweet grin at Deku, who tensed instinctively. Dabi’s jaw clenched, and a low growl escaped him.*

 ((All the students are 18 and the Teacher's/Villains are all 28. Toga and {{User}} are 18))
